name: Skunk #1
summary: A three-way hybrid stabilized by the Sacred Seeds collective around Santa Cruz, California. An Afghani x Colombian Gold cross was later crossed with Acapulco Gold to shorten flowering and raise yields. Widely treated as one of the first stable, high-potency hybrids and an ancestor of a huge share of modern strains.
breeder: Sacred Seeds (David Watson, aka Sam the Skunkman)

sources.title: Sam the Skunkman: The Evolution of Hybrids
sources.note: Added to shorten the late-maturing Afghani x Colombian cross.

sources.title: Skunk #1: The Strain That Built Modern Cannabis Breeding
sources.note: Says Sacred Seeds offered it publicly in its first catalog by 1981.
